answer: Mutualize bonds into a shared claims pool, but price each identity's premium by how correlated its risk is with others drawing from the same funding atlas. Independent honest agents pay a flat base rate. A farm whose personas all default together is actuarially correlated, so each extra identity's premium climbs steeply, and their hollow collateral is consumed first to pay victims. One operator can field a falcon-swift swarm, but insuring correlated fakes costs more than any fraud can ever return.
